title: Millenium State: Path of Hegemony
description: Trace Ukraine’s journey from the early 1990s to the 2040s. Guide your country through geopolitical turbulence, hybrid aggression, and the complex process of nation-building. You’ll delve deep into complex systems: waging hybrid wars, navigating shifting geopolitical dynamics, developing a political leader, and shaping a regime. The game offers an innovative wargame experience—right up to the use of nuclear weapons. You choose the direction of development yourself: from building a stable democracy to establishing a harsh dictatorship. All game mechanics, as well as dozens of historical events and simulated crises (civil wars, invasions, and other global challenges), were developed by a professional political scientist, so they correspond as closely as possible to harsh political realities. What if Ukraine hadn’t signed the Budapest Memorandum, and Russia had split into three separate entities—all while you were in power!
description_short: Deep geopolitical strategy, sandbox. Engage in political processes that are realistic from the perspective of political theory - conduct comprehensive hybrid and military operations within global processes. Develop a leader and respond to historical events.
